settings.name: Ask before a scene
settings.tooltip: When an NPC starts a scene with you, a box asks Yes, No or Skip. Skip fades to black and counts as done. Off: scenes start straight away.

settings.name: Scene flows
settings.tooltip: Build scenes from your animation packs (needs Build Flows.cmd). Off: every scene is plain OStim. On: pick a scene in the menu and the flow steps back for that scene.

settings.name: Finish at excitement
settings.tooltip: A pack's finish scene starts when the man's excitement reaches this.

settings.name: Scene messages
settings.tooltip: Corner messages when a new animation set starts or a position is requested.

settings.name: Live scene lines
settings.tooltip: Tell Mantella about position changes, pace and climaxes during scenes.

settings.name: Talk chance per excitement band
settings.tooltip: Chance she speaks when she warms up, gets into it, or gets close; also the climax coin flip.

settings.name: Seconds between spoken reactions
settings.tooltip: At most one spoken scene reaction per this many seconds.

settings.name: Dirty talk for forward NPCs
settings.tooltip: Forward NPCs may talk dirty during scenes.

settings.name: Bystander comments
settings.tooltip: Conversation members watching the scene comment now and then.

settings.name: Bystander extra chance at peak
settings.tooltip: Added to the chance at arousal 100.
